refresh_cadence: daily (incremental: a tournament settled for two days is reused from the previous snapshot); hourly is never needed, online events are not the event-weekend path
records_captured: Team sheets of qualifying online Champions tournaments: one row per team-sheet slot, with the player's placing, W-L-T record and drop (docs/upgrade-plan-2027q2.md, S1)

fields.name: tournament_name
fields.description: Tournament name as the organiser gave it

fields.name: player_handle
fields.description: The player's Limitless handle (not a legal name)

fields.name: player_name
fields.description: The player's display name on Limitless

fields.name: player_country
fields.description: Two-letter country code, when the player set one

fields.name: placement
fields.description: Final placing; blank for a player who dropped (int_limitless_play_mapped places them after every finisher, by record)

fields.name: pokemon_slug
fields.description: Limitless' species slug (the same convention as limitlessvgc.com), mapped through limitless_slug_to_pokeapi_form

fields.name: tera_type
fields.description: Tera type if listed (Champions has no Tera mechanic; kept raw)

fields.name: fetched_at_utc
fields.description: When this tournament's rows were last fetched from the API. Unlike extracted_at_utc it survives a reuse, so a copy fetched mid-event is fetched again rather than kept (pipelines/extract/limitless_play.py, _is_final).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The tournament's standings (or pairings) page on play.limitlesstcg.com

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Unique row id within the source

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: Online handles are not legal names: never join them to RK9 or MunchStats identities
Organisers choose whether lists are public; a player without a published list has standings and pairings but no roster rows
Monotype and other house-rule events share the format label; the extractor drops Monotype by name and events under 16 players
Unauthenticated rate limit of 50 requests per 5 minutes; a key raises it for public-facing projects
